---
title: "The website image gets its measured size, not the size declared on the site"
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/mark.jpg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="52">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="34">'
        - []
---

The page has no image of its own, so the site's image is used with its measured size, not the declared one.
